1- handstand pushups. They're as complete an upper body exercise as any, and I really enjoy doing them.

3- handstand pushups, sprints and muscle ups- ah, there they are.

5- handstand pushups, sprints, muscle ups, one arm pushups, and leaning calf raises- my calves grow and stay big if I hit them with a ton of volume but they shrink right back down if I don't work them directly for even a couple of months, so call me vain but this isolation exercise makes my top 5.

That's an interesting combination. If you're having trouble with pistols, try elevating your heel and doing them that way, and then reducing the elevation over time to get a true pistol. Start off in shoes with your heel on a plank of wood, then a few workouts later change the plank to a few pieces of thick cardboard, then a couple pieces of cardboard, then just one, until finally you're doing pistols in your shoes. Then just start practicing them without your shoes on to eventually get them barefoot.
